comment: The reason prefixes GET /api/tos/status may emit, and the UI state each maps to. Shared by services/dashboard/routes/tos_status.py's tests and strategy-builder-ui/src/lib/dashboard/tosStatus.ts's tests. Both sides assert this file and both run in CI: the Python side in .github/workflows/test.yml, the TS side in the job named "UI suite (lint + build + tsc + vitest)" in .github/workflows/ui.yml, which is path-gated on strategy-builder-ui/** and tests/fixtures/** and so runs whenever this file changes. Adding a prefix here without a matching statusState branch therefore fails that job instead of landing in the UI as 'unknown'. Kept separate from symbols-reasons.json because the absent/unreadable reasons name a different document, and an operator told 'the symbols document is missing' when the status board is the one missing would look at the wrong exporter. Like the symbols reader this route has no caller-supplied path segment — the document's name is fixed — so it can never refuse an id. No reason ever carries a value read from the document.
